responsibilities.responsibility: One terminal stop result for one captured native transport generation
responsibilities.old_owner: Game mixed UI teardown, mutable connection access, lifecycle flags and asynchronous stop completion; retained-session callers could complete or replace state without one joinable native-stop boundary.
responsibilities.new_owner: TransportStopCoordinator, instantiated per Game/NvConnection and holding the captured stop effect plus a monotonic generation
state_moved: NEW, STARTING, ACTIVE, STOPPING and STOPPED transport lifecycle
one terminal Result shared by every same-generation stop caller
weak predecessor barrier preventing a newer transport from starting before the captured predecessor reaches STOPPED
effects_moved: the first stop caller claims STOPPING and executes the exact captured NvConnection.stop effect
native stop still runs if Game teardown throws
callbacks are released only after native stop returns and callback failures cannot prevent other joiners
callers_migrated: Game connection start and stop paths
retained disconnect and whole-session termination paths
obsolete_paths_removed: successful completion based only on connected=false or UI teardown
late lookup of a mutable connection for the stop effect
separate terminate/disconnect effects that could both report success
replacement start bypass through an unstarted intermediate generation

responsibilities.old_owner: RetainedStreamSessionCoordinator exposed TERMINATING state without a typed operation that all callers could join; direct completion could be correlated by reusable IDs.
responsibilities.new_owner: RetainedStreamSessionCoordinator typed termination operation and identity-bound DirectTermination token
state_moved: exact owner plus session/host/app correlation for restore
effects_moved: mixed terminate/disconnect requests fail closed without a second effect
stale tokens and stale owners cannot restore Home or overwrite a newer operation
callers_migrated: Game direct quit and retained disconnect
ConsoleActivity whole-session completion and replacement wait
obsolete_paths_removed: fake HOME_LIVE restoration after unsafe local stop
ID-only Console restore and indirect stale openConsoleHome ownership takeover

remaining_monolith_responsibilities: Game remains the Android presentation/lifecycle adapter and supplies concrete teardown and native connection effects.
S07 retains relocation of the complete physical stream runtime.
test_seam: Package-local deterministic coordinators use injected synchronous effects/executors; latch, failure, stale-token and A-to-B-to-C ordering tests require no device or sleeps.
